summary: Detector fired on gross size and cancels after fills. The tape shows a pegged execution algo re-pricing two symmetric child orders (one BUY, one SELL, each 2071) under parents P-T-X1102-02-B and -S, at or one tick off the touch, with no order near 3x depth. Cancels are symmetric (0.996). Price did not move in the trader's favour (0.0 ticks) and did not revert. No public event or risk event. The BUY order traded 481 before any SELL fill, so it was working. No core spoofing feature is present.

Three BUY limit orders of 4418 each (13254 total, about 5.6x top-5 depth) were placed 5s apart at 9992-9993, 2 ticks from the touch, and a 662 SELL filled at 9998 at 11:10:02.280. All three BUYs were cancelled at 11:10:03.280, the same millisecond a recorded intraday-loss-limit kill switch cancelled all resting orders. The bid rose 1.5 ticks before the sale, but reversion after the cancel was 0.0, so there is no favourable-move-and-reversion benefit. No single order reached 3x depth. Closed as a risk-system cancellation. This is a borderline close, because the side was one-sided and large in aggregate.

Agency trader's single large BUY ICEBERG (17456, 7.14x depth) was working: 6709 (38%) executed before the only opposite-side trade, a 436 SELL under a different parent (a different client's order). The price move was 0.5 tick with no reversion, so there was no benefit. The remainder was cancelled 2s after the SELL. Both core features are absent and genuine execution of an iceberg order is supported.

Pegged execution algo (ALGO-EXEC) refreshing paired BUY and SELL child orders of two parents, each 2078 (its typical size, 0.85x depth), at or beside the touch. Cancels are symmetric (0.99) and follow the touch. There was no favourable price move and no reversion. The single opposite-side fill (518 SELL) was a third party hitting a resting order. The 70 BUY fill came after it. No one-sided large order, no public event, no risk event. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported. Neither core feature is present.

Prop trader bought 1354 at market (14:55:43), then layered three BUY limits of 4876 each at 10001/10000/9999 (gross 14628, about 6x avg top-5 depth) with no fills. At 14:56:03.778 the trader sold 863 at market (10003/10002), and all three bids were cancelled 600 ms later. Feature (b) looks weak: price moved -3 ticks, there was no reversion and the round trip was -6.1 ticks. Feature (a) is not excluded: the one-sided layered bids had zero executions, were cancelled right after the opposite-side sale, and no accepted explanation covers them. The evidence is mixed, so I escalate rather than close.

Registered ETF-MM market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a SELL (3819, its typical size) and a small BUY (763) in pairs every ~3s, cancelling and re-pricing both together. The detector's 'BUY cancelled after SELL execution' is the BUY quote being pulled with the SELL quote at each re-quote. The SELL orders themselves were executing (12207 filled). There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution, so there is no benefit and no price move in the trader's favour. No single order reached 3x depth, with a maximum of 1.56x depth. Features (a) and (b) are both absent and market making is supported.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM desk) re-quoting a bid and an ask of 2661 (its typical size) at the touch roughly every 2s. Both sides are cancelled and replaced together (cancel_symmetry 0.98). Fills were on the quotes themselves. There is no favourable price move (price_move_ticks 0.0), no single order of 3x depth or more, no event, and no repetition beyond the quoting cycle. The detector fired on gross submitted size from the re-quoting. Neither core feature is present.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size of 2853, re-quoting every 2-3 s. Cancels are symmetric (0.985) and follow the touch. No single order reached 3x depth (peak 1.22x). Price moved 1 tick against the trader before its opposite-side fills, with no reversion, and the round trip is negative. Both core features are absent, and market making is supported.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size of 3592. Bid and ask are placed and cancelled together (cancel_symmetry 0.99). The quotes follow the touch. No single order reaches 3x depth (max 1.54x). The round trip is slightly negative (-0.35 ticks). The detector fired on gross two-sided quote churn, not on a one-sided displayed order. Fills on the quotes were ordinary two-sided executions. One caution: the aggregate price_move_ticks of 1.5 and reversion of 3.0 are non-zero. They come from two-sided quotes that track the mid, and there is no one-sided resting order or beneficial opposite fill behind them.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size of 2748 and re-quoting every 2-3s. Cancels are symmetric across sides and follow the touch. No single order reached 3x depth. There was no favourable price move (price_move_ticks 0) and no reversion. The detector fired on gross size and cancel ratio, which fit quoting. Features (a) and (b) are both absent.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting both sides every ~3s at its typical size. Its SELL quotes were repeatedly executed (10,289 filled; 4,954 before the only opposite-side trade). The only opposite-side execution was a 2-lot BUY. No reversion after the cancels, and no single order reached 3x depth. Feature (a) is absent because the resting orders were trading; feature (b) is absent because the opposite fill was trivial and the price did not revert. Proposed CLOSE_FP.

Pegged execution algo on ALGO-EXEC re-pricing paired BUY/SELL children of two parents (P-T-X1104-06-B / -S) at the touch, each about 1x depth. Cancels are symmetric (0.99). The BUY side executed 2391 before any opposite fill, so the resting order was working. There was no favourable price move and no reversion. Closure standard met: algorithmic re-pricing supported, features (a) and (b) absent.

Detector fired on gross BUY size vs depth with small SELL executions. The tape shows a PEGGED two-sided algo (children of parents P-T-X1104-07-B and -S) re-pricing at the touch at its typical size of 2580, roughly 1.1x depth. Cancels are symmetric (0.99). Price did not move in the trader's favour (0.0 ticks) and there was no reversion. No single order reached 3x depth. Feature (a) is absent because the orders are pegged children quoting both sides. Feature (b) is absent because there was no favourable move or reversion. Proposing CLOSE_FP.

Registered market maker on SYN.A (ETF-MM desk) re-quoting both sides at its typical size of 2688, about 1.15x depth. Bid and ask are cancelled together and re-posted at the new touch about every 2s. Cancel symmetry is 0.99, with no large one-sided order, no event and no repetition of a one-sided cycle. The ~1.3 tick round trip is spread income from two-sided quoting, not a one-sided benefit. The detector fired on gross quoting volume against depth. Closing as market making.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided SELL limit of 25,977 (11.1x avg top-5 depth) 3 ticks from the touch, bought 500 at market 3.0s later while it rested, and cancelled the whole SELL 465 ms after the buy. The order had no fills. The price moved 1.5 ticks in the trader's favour and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. No news, no risk event, no MM registration, no parent order. Both core features are present and no legitimate explanation is supported. This is a single cycle with a small benefit (500 shares), so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 rather than DRAFT_STOR.

Prop trader (no MM registration) bought 979 by market order at 10006-10007, then placed three one-sided BUY limits of 3526 (10578 total, 4.5x depth) at 9997-9998, 4-6 ticks below the touch. It then sold 979 at 10000 by market order, and all three bids were cancelled 600 ms later. None of the bids executed. Feature (a), an order not intended to execute, is plausibly present. Feature (b) is not shown: the price moved -3 ticks, there was no reversion and the round trip is -6.1 ticks. A stop-out explains the sale but not the 10578 of resting bids, so no accepted explanation is supported and the evidence is mixed. Escalate to Level 2.

ALGO-EXEC trader T-X1105-01 ran two pegged child-order streams (parents P-T-X1105-01-B and -S) on SYN.A. Both sides were refreshed in lockstep at the touch, at the desk's typical size of 2646, which is about 1.04x depth. Cancel symmetry is 0.99, no single order reached 3x depth, price_move is only 0.5 tick with 0 reversion, and the roughly 2.4-tick round trip is spread income from two-sided quoting. This is algorithmic re-pricing. Neither core feature is present. The detector fired on gross size and cancels, and the cancels simply follow the touch.

Pegged execution algo (ALGO-EXEC) refreshing two-sided child orders of two parents (P-T-X1105-02-B and P-T-X1105-02-S) at the touch. Each order is about 1x depth (2524 vs 2549 depth); there is no single order of 3x depth or more. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99) and follow the touch. The resting orders were executing: 946 filled on the SELL side before any opposite-side trade. The one opposite-side fill (BUY 195) came with price_move -1 tick (against the trader) and zero reversion. The round trip of 2.7 ticks is two-sided spread income, not a benefit from a one-sided order. Both core features are absent and algorithmic re-pricing is supported. Propose CLOSE_FP.

Trader T-X1105-03 placed a one-sided BUY LIMIT of 31561 (12.4x depth, 4 ticks from touch) at 12:27:21.209. At 12:27:22.949 the trader sold 1539 by market order, and cancelled the whole BUY 312.6 ms later. The BUY had no executions. The trader is a registered MM only on SYN.B, not SYN.A, and no event, risk cut or other legitimate explanation is supported. Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is unclear: the price move was +1 tick with no reversion. The case is one occurrence, so I escalate to Level 2 and do not propose a STOR draft.

Detector fired on gross BUY size vs depth and a SELL fill of 80 followed by a BUY cancel. The tape shows a pegged execution algo re-pricing two parent orders (P-T-X1105-04-B and -S). The 2211-lot children are refreshed on both sides, one after the other. Cancels are symmetric (0.9987). Orders sit at the touch and are 0.87x depth, so none is large. The 80 SELL fill was on the algo's own sell child. The price moved -0.5 ticks with no reversion. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent.

Two BUY limit orders of 6325 each (12650 total, about 5x depth, 1.5 ticks from the touch) rested at 10003. The trader sold 451 at 10007 at 15:34:41.334. The two buys were cancelled together at 15:34:44.000, 166 ms after an unscheduled issuer trading update at 15:34:43.834, with 4 other cancels in the prior second. The sale came BEFORE the news, which fits the desk feedback (hedge placed before the news). The price did not revert after the cancel (reversion 0.0, post-cancel move +6.5 ticks, so the sale was at a worse price than where the market went). There is no repetition and no prior alert. The price effect is only +1 tick with no reversion, so feature (b) is not shown. The cancel is explained by the public event. Some doubt remains: a one-sided buy that is 5x depth sitting next to a small sell is unusual, and the orders were not executed.

ALGO-EXEC pegged algorithm on SYN.A re-pricing two-sided child orders of two parents (B and S). Every order is 1677 (the desk's typical size, 0.66x depth at most). Cancels are symmetric (0.99) and follow the touch. The opposite-side fills of 1200 came with a price move of -0.5 ticks and no reversion. The window has no large order, no favourable move and no repetition. Both core features are absent and algorithmic re-pricing is supported, so I propose a close as false positive.

Detector fired on BUY gross size vs depth and SELL fills followed by BUY cancels. The tape shows a pegged two-sided algo (ALGO-EXEC) refreshing equal-size BUY and SELL child orders of two parents at the touch. Cancels are symmetric, no single order is large, and the price did not move or revert. The pattern is algorithmic re-pricing, with no unexecuted-intent order and no benefit from a price move.

ALGO-EXEC pegged algo continuously re-pricing one BUY and one SELL child order (parents P-T-X1106-02-B and -S) at its typical size of 2834 (1.17x depth). Cancels are symmetric (0.999) and follow the touch. No single order reaches 3x depth, no price move before the fills, no reversion. Fills were small ordinary partial fills. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported and neither core feature is present.

PROP trader (no registered MM) placed one BUY limit of 27,878 (11.49x top-5 depth, 3 ticks from touch) at 11:17:10.619. 1.8s later a SELL market order executed 1,090 at 9996 down to 9991, and the BUY was cancelled in full 499ms after that. The BUY had no fills, was one-sided (cancel_symmetry 0.0), and the bid moved +2 ticks before the sell and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. The discriminators show 6 repetitions in the session. No event, risk cut or other legitimate explanation is supported. Level 2 should draft the STOR.

Three BUY limit orders of 4704 each (14112 total, 5.8x depth) were laddered at 10000/9999/9997 over about 10s. One SELL of 705 filled at 10003 at 11:48:15.148. All three BUYs were cancelled together at 11:48:16.148, the same timestamp as a recorded automated kill-switch (intraday loss limit breached). The sell did not benefit from price: price_move_ticks -0.5, no post-cancel move or reversion. No repetition, no prior alerts. The risk-limit cancellation is supported and feature (b) is absent. The ladder was one-sided and unfilled, so feature (a) cannot be proven absent from the tape alone. L2 may want to check why the loss limit was hit.

Prop trader (no MM registration) placed one SELL LIMIT of 24907 (10.3x depth, 3 ticks from touch) at 13:45:54.608 and had no fills on it. It bought 696 by market order at 10005 at 13:45:56.827 and cancelled the full SELL 188 ms later. Feature (a), an order not meant to execute, is present. Feature (b) is not shown: the price move was -0.5 ticks (adverse), there was no reversion and no round trip is available. No accepted explanation is supported, and the pattern is recorded as repeating 3 times in the session. The evidence is mixed with no supported explanation, so I propose escalation to Level 2, not closure. I did not propose DRAFT_STOR because there is no demonstrated benefit.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided BUY limit of 21,575 (8.9x avg top-5 depth, 2 ticks from touch, ~43x typical size 500) at 13:11:00.352. 2.0s later a SELL market order of 879 executed, and the BUY was fully cancelled 156 ms after that. The BUY had no executions. No registered MM, no parent/pegged orders, no risk event, no public news. Both core features are present and no accepted explanation is supported. The benefit is small (0.5 tick move with 0.5 tick reversion, one cycle, no repetition), so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 rather than DRAFT_STOR.

Agency trader's 20512 BUY ICEBERG (8.45x depth, parent C-T-X1106-08-A) was working: 14527 (70.8%) executed before the single 512 SELL, which is under a different parent (C-T-X1106-08-B) and so is a different client's order. Price move 0.5 tick, no reversion. The remainder of 5573 was cancelled after further fills. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent. Closing as false positive.

Prop trader placed a one-sided BUY limit of 23451 (9.66x avg top-5 depth) 4 ticks from the touch. About 2s later a SELL market order executed 1115 across several levels. The BUY was cancelled in full 288 ms after that trade. It had no fills, was never reduced, and no other order was resting on the other side. No public event, risk event, market-making registration or parent order explains it. The price moved 2 ticks in the trader's favour and reverted 1 tick after the cancel. Both core features appear present and no legitimate explanation is supported, so I propose ESCALATE. It is a single cycle with no prior alerts, so I do not propose DRAFT_STOR. Caveat: the sell swept down to 9990, the level of the resting buy, so some of the sell price path may be the trader's own sweep.

Single BUY 22140 (9.12x depth) placed 1 tick below the touch, cancelled after 1.3 s with no fills on either side. 400 ms later the same trader placed a BUY of 2214 at the same price, exactly one tenth of the size. This looks like a size-entry (decimal) error that was corrected. There was no opposite-side execution, so no benefit (feature b). The pattern is one-off. Closed as a fat finger, with moderate confidence because the large order was alive for 1.3 s and the trader has no history to compare against.

Prop trader bought 1413 at market (09:23:05), then placed three one-sided BUY limits of 5086 each at 9995/9994/9993 (total 15258, 5.9x depth, 5-7 ticks from touch). 18s later sold 1413 at market (738 filled at 9997/9996), and all three bids were cancelled 600 ms after. Resting bids had no executions and cancel_symmetry is 0. The price moved against the seller (-2 ticks), with no reversion and a negative round trip, so a benefit (b) is not shown. However no accepted explanation covers the layered bids: the trader is not a registered MM, there is no news, risk event or parent order. Evidence is mixed, so escalate to Level 2 rather than close.

One-sided BUY limit of 24084 (9.33x avg top-5 depth) placed 4 ticks below the touch with nothing on the other side. The trader sold 1171 by market order 2.2s later and cancelled the whole BUY 416 ms after that. The order had no executions. No legitimate explanation is supported: the trader is a registered MM on SYN.B only, and there is no event, risk event or parent order. The benefit is not shown: price_move 0 and reversion 0 mean the sell was not at a favourable price. Feature (a) looks present and (b) is not demonstrated. The evidence is mixed and the closure standard is not met, so I escalate. The pattern did not repeat (1 repetition), so I do not propose a STOR draft. Level 2 drafts any STOR.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (2529), re-quoting every 2-3 s with bid and ask cancelled together. No single order reached 3x depth, the price did not move in the trader's favour, there was no reversion, and no spoofing benefit. The detector counted the gross two-sided quote flow as one-sided size.

One BUY LIMIT of 24250 (9.4x depth) at 9994, 1 tick below the bid, was cancelled after 1.16s. 0.4s later the trader placed a BUY of 2425, exactly one tenth of the size and one tick higher. This looks like a decimal-place entry error that was corrected. There was no opposite-side execution, no fill, no price benefit and no repetition. Feature (b) is absent. Feature (a) is not supported, because the corrected order shows the trader meant to buy, at the intended size.

A single BUY of 18,050 (6.99x depth) was placed 1 tick behind the touch and cancelled 1.53s later. The trader made no opposite-side execution, so there was no benefit and no price move. 0.4s after the cancel, the trader sent a corrected BUY of 1,805, exactly one tenth of the size, at the touch. That order was partly filled (157). This fits an entry-size (fat-finger) error with a correction. It is a one-off, with no repetition in the session and no prior alerts.

Registered market maker on SYN.A (desk ETF-MM) quoting both sides in 2810 lots, the desk's typical size, and re-quoting every 2-3 seconds. Bid and ask cancels are simultaneous (cancel_symmetry 0.996). No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.09x). The 440 opposite-side fill was on its own resting quote, after 1188 same-side fills (more than the opposite qty). Price move was 0.5 tick with 0 reversion, and the round trip was 1 tick of spread. This is ordinary market-making income, not spoofing. Detector fired on gross size and OTR only.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (2820, about 1.09x depth) and re-pricing with the touch. Cancels are symmetric (0.94). No single order is 3x depth, there is no favourable price move with reversion, and the round trip is negative. The detector fired on the fills on the SELL quote, which it read as opposite-side executions, while the BUY quote was cancelled on a re-quote. Neither core feature is present.

ALGO-EXEC trader quoting both sides of SYN.A with PEGGED child orders under two parents (P-T-X1109-08-B and -S). Orders are typical size (2357), at the touch and below depth. Cancels are near-perfectly symmetric across sides (0.989). No price move before the opposite-side fills and no reversion. No public event or risk event. Pattern is algorithmic re-pricing, not spoofing. The detector fired on gross submitted size from the constant re-pegging.

Prop trader (no MM registration) placed five SELL limits of 5670 each at 10003-10007 within about 60 ms. That is 28350 in total, about 11x average top-5 depth. A 1417 MARKET BUY then executed at the ask, 10002. All five SELL orders were cancelled 0.6-0.8s later with zero fills. The pattern is one-sided and multi-level, and no legitimate explanation is supported. Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is not clearly shown: the price did not move in the trader's favour and did not revert. The evidence is mixed, so it goes to Level 2. It is not a STOR draft, because there is no repetition and no measured benefit.

Algo trader T-X1109-10 placed one BUY LIMIT of 27267 (10.57x depth) at 9996, 3 ticks from the touch, with no parent order and nothing on the other side. 2.8s later it sold 1409 by MARKET at the touch (price move +1.5 ticks in its favour). The BUY was cancelled in full 154 ms after the sale. The BUY had no fills. Prior closures cited a pegged algo with symmetric cancels and a parent order; none of that is on today's tape. No legitimate explanation is supported. Escalate to Level 2. This is not a DRAFT_STOR proposal: one cycle in the window and the favourable move is modest.

Single BUY O-00003267 (14655, 5.98x depth, 1 tick behind the touch) was working: 3516 (24%) executed before the trader's only opposite-side trade (SELL 439 at 09:42:11). The small sell while it was working and the later 9457 MODIFY reduction are ordinary order management. There is no favourable move with reversion (price_move 0.5, reversion null), so feature (b) is absent. No repetition, no prior alerts. Proposing CLOSE_FP.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting both sides at its typical size of 3121, about 1.27x depth. Cancels are symmetric (0.97) and happen in pairs. The price did not move for the trader and did not revert. No single order reached 3x depth. Its fills were on its own quotes. Neither core feature is present. Detector fired on gross quote churn.

ALGO-EXEC trader quoted both sides at the touch with PEGGED child orders of two parents (P-T-X1110-05-B and P-T-X1110-05-S). Each child was 2,250, which is below average depth, and children were re-pegged continuously in lockstep. Cancels were symmetric (0.993). There were no market events and no risk events. Feature (a) is absent because the orders are pegged children of parents. Feature (b) is absent because there was no favourable move and no reversion. The detector fired on the churn of re-pegging.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a bid and an ask of 3154 each, cancelling and replacing them in pairs about every 2-3 seconds and following the mid up from 10000/10002 to 10003/10004. The detector fired because the BUY side was large against depth and was cancelled soon after SELL fills. Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides in a continuous cycle at its typical size of 2286. Bid and ask are cancelled together and re-quoted, and the cancels follow the touch.
